note: Way ids are ORS's own (extra_info osmid), present only on the four wheelchair configurations listed. A way's highway tag is looked up in graph/osm_tags.json, which holds every OSM way this graph is built from, 5,551 of them steps. 28,514 of 3,030,948 way ids on the reference routes (0.9%) are not in that file, so a steps way among them would be missed. The foot-walking runs were made without way ids, so there is no positive control from routes in this file.
